default.notes: Apply online at evisa.tj — USD 50 single-entry eVisa for up to 60 days; add the GBAO permit in the same application if visiting the Pamirs.

groups.notes: Visa-free for up to 30 days under Tajikistan's January 2022 visa-waiver expansion — a GBAO permit is still needed for the Pamir Highway.
Visa-free under CIS-era bilateral agreements — long stays are permitted, but registration rules can apply; confirm the exact allowance before staying beyond 90 days.
Visa-free for up to 90 days under the bilateral agreement with Türkiye.

TJ.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Tajik citizens.

UZ.notes: Visa-free for up to 30 days under the 2018 bilateral agreement with Uzbekistan.

IR.notes: Visa-free for short tourist stays under the Iran–Tajikistan waiver agreement in force since 2024 — confirm current implementation before travel.

AF.notes: Afghan citizens are not eligible for the eVisa — apply at a Tajik embassy; approval involves additional checks and border crossings may be restricted.
